title: Assessment of Flecainide versus Bisoprolol as First-Line Treatment for Premature Ventricular Contractions: a Multicenter Randomized Clinical Trial
official: AVISO - Assessment of Flecainide versus Bisoprolol as First-Line Treatment for Premature Ventricular Contractions: a Multicenter Randomized Clinical Trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of flecainide versus bisoprolol to treat ventricular premature contractions
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years-old
2. ≥ 1 symptom (palpitations, presyncope, dyspnea, fatigue) present within a month before inclusion
3. Absence of indication for first line catheter ablation (PVC not easily amenable to catheter ablation or multifocal PVC) OR patient refusal for first-line catheter ablation
4. LVEF ≥ 45% by transthoracic echocardiography of cardiac magnetic resonance imaging
5. Ischemic heart disease ruled out (no myocardial ischemia or significant coronary artery disease at stress ECG or TTE or coronary CT or stress MRI or coronary angiography, performed less than 1-year before randomization)
6. Affiliated to Social Security
7. Signed written consent form
Exclusion criteria:
1. Familial channelopathy (long QT syndrome, Brugada syndrome, cathecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia)
2. Sustained atrial arrhythmia (atrial fibrillation, tachycardia, flutter)
3. Congestive heart failure (signs or symptoms, elevated NT-proBNP)
4. Any of the following abnormality found at electrocardiogram at inclusion visit: presence of QRS width >120 ms, Pre-excitation, any degree of AV-block, except due to enhanced vagal tone (e.g. Wencheback-block at night in young athletes or 1st degree AV block that disappears during exercise)
5. Abnormal liver or kidney function (AST/ALT three times upper normal, eGRF <50 ml/min/m2)
6. Asthma requiring bronchodilation therapy
7. Currently receiving treatment in any other investigational device or drug trial, or less than 30 days since ending treatment on another investigational device or drug trial.
8. Previous hypokalemia (potassium level <3 mmol per liter)
9. Known ongoing pregnancy or lactation for a women of childbearing potential*Known hypersensibility to flecainide or bisoprolol or their excipients (see SmPC of the provided specialities), or contraindications to flecainide or bisoprolol
10. Known hypersensibility to flecainide or bisoprolol or their excipients (see SmPC of the provided specialities), or contraindications to flecainide or bisoprolol
11. Intended use of a prohibited medication
12. Patient under guardianship, judicial protection or curatorship
13. Genetic cardiomyopathy (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, dilated cardiomyopathy, including genotype positive phenotype negative individuals)
14. Active myocarditis or previous myocarditis with sequalae
15. Sustained ventricular tachycardia (≥30 s)
